about: Plan Milestone 4 item 4; spec-edit-guard.md 06 item 3; spec-run-manager.md 08.4 item 3; CONTRACT.md 4 item 5. Both requests passed and mark closed them. Then a stray write moves r1's link line below r1's comment. The real Edit guard raises link-line-invalid (the link line) and close-invalid (r1). act puts r1's request line back to its snapshot text (- [r]) and removes the link line, which sits elsewhere in the request's block, so it is found by the flag's 'after' text.
